description: Get train punctuality of a Polish passenger rail carrier from PKP PLK open rail data: number of runs, share on time (arrival at the final station under 6 minutes late), average delay, cancellations, comparison with all carriers in Poland and rank, day-by-day series, punctuality by category/line, worst trains and runs. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.
